subject: Initiate security questionnaire + clarifying scope for MediSecure
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Luke Turner <luke.turner@medisecure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate security questionnaire + clarifying scope for MediSecure

Hi Luke — great conversation today. Thanks for taking the time to walk through your security expectations. Per our call, we want to kick off the formal questionnaire work so your security team can validate controls and evidence.

Quick recap and clarifying questions:
- Desired assessment: you mentioned wanting a SIG/CAIQ baseline plus a small custom control mapping for PHI handling. Can you confirm whether you prefer SIG (standard) or a CAIQ-first approach?
- SOC 2 status: do you need us to provide SOC 2 Type II reports, or is Type I / roadmap sufficient for initial onboarding?
- HIPAA scope: confirm whether data we will process is PHI at rest or only in-transit/de-identified — this affects evidence needs.
- Data residency: you said US-only — which region (us-east/us-west) should we include in the questionnaire?
- Timeline: what is your target date to complete review? You mentioned the end of July — is that firm?

Next steps I propose (feel free to adjust):
1) I’ll attach a SIG-lite prefill (short answers) and a proposed control mapping for PHI — Ben will own the evidence collection.
2) If you confirm SIG vs CAIQ preference and SOC 2 expectations, we’ll prefill and return within 5 business days.
3) Ben will set up a secure evidence share link and sync with your procurement team for any contract redlines.

Attachments: SIG-lite-prefill.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation on SIG/CAIQ preference and SOC 2 requirement.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Luke Turner <luke.turner@medisecure.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Mei Chang <mei.chang@medisecure.com>, security@medisecure.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiate security questionnaire + clarifying scope for MediSecure

Evelyn — thanks for the recap and the clear plan. Quick answers below: 

- SIG vs CAIQ: SIG is preferred as the baseline for us; a CAIQ prefill is OK if you find it faster, but we’d like a SIG mapping as the final deliverable.
- SOC 2: We currently have SOC 2 Type I completed (Q1 2027) and expect Type II in Q4 2027. For initial procurement, Type I + roadmap and compensating controls is acceptable.
- HIPAA: Yes — we will be sharing limited PHI in the integration. Controls around access logging, separation, and encryption at-rest are required.
- Data residency: US-East (us-east-1) is preferred.
- Timeline: End of July is still our target for completion of procurement review, but we may need a short extension if additional evidence is requested.

I attached our internal security requirements doc for reference (MediSecure_Security_Requirements.pdf). Also, procurement (cc’d) will need any contract redlines and an estimated SOW for evidence collection.

If you can send the SIG prefill with suggested evidence mapping by next Wednesday (15 Jun), that would be great.

— Luke
Luke Turner
Head of IT Security | MediSecure Health
luke.turner@medisecure.com | +1 (617) 555-2110

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Initiate security questionnaire + clarifying scope for MediSecure

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Luke’s answers (below). Key takeaways for us:
- SIG baseline preferred; CAIQ acceptable for rapid prefill but deliverable should be SIG mapping.
- SOC 2 Type I available; Type II expected Q4 — Type I + roadmap acceptable for now.
- HIPAA / PHI in scope — focus on access logs, encryption at-rest, and separation of environments.
- Data residency: us-east-1.
- Target completion end of July; Luke asked for SIG prefill by 15 Jun.

Action items: 
- Ben: own evidence collection and set up a secure evidence share (recommend SharePoint folder with restricted access). Please start compiling the SOC 2 Type I report, encryption configs, and access-log exports.
- Marissa: coordinate with Product on PHI control mapping and confirm whether any architectural diagrams need redaction before sharing.
- I’ll produce a SIG-lite prefill and a mapping doc and send to Luke by EOD 15 Jun.

Quoted message below for context.

Regards,
Evelyn
